title: Compliance access orchestration: JIT provisioning, SCIM hardening, and automated certification
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Purpose: Implement a unified access control orchestration flow that ties RBAC, SSO/SAML, and SCIM provisioning into periodic certification and evidence exports compatible with audit requirements. Goal is to reduce manual evidence collection, enable just-in-time (JIT) provisioning for privileged roles, and produce signed export bundles for compliance teams.

Scope and deliverables:
- RBAC schema refinement: canonicalize role-to-permission mappings and a machine-readable role graph to be used by console, runtime, and exported evidence.
- SCIM hardening and backfill: address attribute mapping mismatches for external IdPs, add delta-syncs for membership reconciliation, and implement a safe backfill to populate missing tenant scoping attributes.
- JIT provisioning workflow: prototype time-bound elevation flows for sensitive roles with enforced MFA and automatic expiry; surface approvals in Console and record audit events.
- Periodic access certification automation: scheduled reviewer assignments, reminder cadence, and bulk evidence attachments (signed snapshots of group memberships and role assignments) that meet audit export schema.
- Evidence/reporting automation: export format (JSON + signed manifest), residency tags for each evidence artifact, retention metadata, and an S3-compatible signed export endpoint for auditors.
- Integrations: tie with KMS for signing, ensure SCIM events create traceable log entries with residency metadata, and add metrics to Console (coverage %, pending reviews, drift rate).

Risk & constraints:
- Backfilling SCIM attributes risks incorrect membership: we will implement an incremental backfill with sampling and user-notifications.
- JIT elevation could increase ticketing overhead: initial rollout limited to 2 tenant groups and 3 roles.
- Export residency: some evidence may include cross-region metadata; ensure residency tags and allow tenant-scoped exports only.

Acceptance criteria:
- RBAC graph available via API and visible in Console role editor.
- SCIM sync resolves > 95% of previously-missing tenant attributes in test tenants without manual fixes.
- JIT elevation flow audited end-to-end with signed events and auto-expiry in <= 24h.
- Scheduled certification runs generate signed export bundles that match audit schema and can be downloaded from Console or pushed to a tenant S3 endpoint.

Rollout plan:
1) Internal alpha with Platform & Security (2 tenants)
2) Beta with 10 controlled customer tenants and opt-in export feature
3) General availability with migration tooling and admin guides

comments: 2025-02-19: Kickoff with Product, Security, and Platform. Agreed to prioritize JIT for admin/ops roles first.
2025-02-25: Design review: consensus on signed export manifest format (SHA256 + KMS signature). Action: Jordan to prototype signer service.
2025-02-27: Security requested retention mapping for each artifact — added residency and retention metadata to export schema; see PR #72.
2025-03-01: Engineering spike complete: SCIM delta-sync reduces missing attributes from 14% -> 3% in staging. Need to validate edge cases with nested groups.

Implementation notes: use existing audit-log pipeline (runtime-audit-stream) and augment events with residency tag and evidence_id for bundle correlation. Console UX to surface pending certs and allow batch attestations.
